name: risk-control-modeling
description: Interactive end-to-end credit risk modeling expert: requirement clarification, data cleaning, credit feature analysis (monthly PSI/IV), tree-model development & evaluation (XGBoost/LightGBM/DNN/LR, AUC/KS/PSI), default model scoring, and on-demand FICO/business reports — with a single orchestrator, split deferred to training-time, unified shared metrics, and key decisions confirmed by the user.

displayDescription.en: End-to-end credit risk modeling: requirement clarification, data cleaning, feature analysis, tree-model development & evaluation, and default model scoring — a single orchestrator with split deferred to training-time, unified shared metrics, and interactive confirmation at key steps. Deployment-ready models.
displayDescription.zh: 专注信贷风控建模全流程：需求澄清、数据清洗、特征分析、模型训练调优与评估、定版默认打分。单一调度者编排、切分后置到训练消费时、指标计算统一共享，关键环节交互确认，产出可上线模型。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我基于这份信贷数据构建风控模型，数据、目标与关键方案请先确认再执行
defaultInitPrompt.en: Build a credit risk model from this dataset — confirm data, target and key decisions before executing

quickPrompts.en: Build a credit risk model from this dataset — confirm target and train/test/OOT window before executing
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我基于这份信贷数据构建风控模型，目标与切分窗口先确认再执行

quickPrompts.en: Run data cleaning and feature analysis, then train a baseline model
quickPrompts.zh: 先做数据清洗和特征分析，再训练 baseline 模型

quickPrompts.zh: 训练并调优一个树模型，超参数和训练窗口划分先给我确认
